blocks.raw: # Configure LINE Content
blocks.text: Configure LINE Content

blocks.raw: The line is an app-based instant messaging platform. You can develop different messages for Line either from the scratch or using existing templates and customize the message content as required.

blocks.raw: # Card message
blocks.text: Card message

blocks.raw: A Card message consists of text, image, and action (Call to action or CTA). You can add up to 10 images in a single message. Each message can have a redirection URL or text reply action (in a carousel format). You can create a Card message or use an existing template from the library.
blocks.text: A Card message consists of text, image, and action (Call to action or CTA). You can add up to 10 images in a single message. Each message can have a redirection URL or text reply action (in a carousel format). You can create a Card message or use an existing template from the library.

blocks.raw:
Prerequisites\
Before starting with creating a Card message, you need to have the image(s) available in your local system with the following properties.
blocks.text: PrerequisitesBefore starting with creating a Card message, you need to have the image(s) available in your local system with the following properties.

blocks.raw:
* Image dimension: 1024 x 1024 pixels
* Image size should not exceed 1 MB per file
* Image format: JPEG or PNG
blocks.text: Image dimension: 1024 x 1024 pixelsImage size should not exceed 1 MB per fileImage format: JPEG or PNG

blocks.raw: # Rich message
blocks.text: Rich message

blocks.raw: A Rich message is an image with multiple clickable areas that you can use to redirect recipients to different pages. You can create a Rich message or use an existing template from the template library.
blocks.text: A Rich message is an image with multiple clickable areas that you can use to redirect recipients to different pages. You can create a Rich message or use an existing template from the template library.

blocks.raw: There are two types of layouts for a Rich Message.
blocks.text: There are two types of layouts for a Rich Message.

blocks.raw:
* **Square**:  An image of size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.
* **Custom**: An image of size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.
blocks.text: Square:  An image of size 1040 × 1040 with multiple clickable grid areas.Custom: An image of size ranging from 1040 × (520 to 2080) with a single clickable area.

blocks.raw: # Bubble message
blocks.text: Bubble message

blocks.raw: Bubble Message is a head-like chat icon that floats on top of the messaging apps screen. A bubble message can have up to five messages and either be created using a single message type or with a combination of different message types - Text Message, Image, Rich Message, or Stickers. You can add, remove, and reorder messages in a bubble as required.

You can add, remove, and reorder messages in a bubble as required.

blocks.raw: # Rich video message
blocks.text: Rich video message

blocks.raw: Line messages in Engage+ support video messages. You can create a new rich video message or use an existing video from the video library.

blocks.raw: You need to have the video in your local system or the video library with the following conditions.
blocks.text: You need to have the video in your local system or the video library with the following conditions.

* Supported video format: MP4
